description: This file contains the PHP source code for the Marketing report controller in the OpenCart admin extension. It defines the 'Marketing' class, extending the core Controller class, and includes methods for handling report display, data retrieval, and settings management related to marketing campaigns.

classes.name: Marketing
classes.description: Controller class for handling marketing reports in the OpenCart admin extension. Provides methods for displaying, saving settings, and generating marketing reports.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of the marketing report form in the admin panel, setting up breadcrumbs, page title, and loading the marketing form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes saving the marketing report configuration settings. Checks permissions, updates settings, and returns a JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Preparing and displaying the marketing report, including fetching report data, handling pagination, and rendering the report view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of marketing report data as JSON, likely used for AJAX calls to load report data dynamically.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates a report based on filters such as date range and order status, returning the report view with data.
